title: JADEPUFFER-Linked Attackers Used Compromised Service Principals to Delete Azure Resources
summary: The threat actor known as JADEPUFFER has been observed orchestrating destructive actions within a Microsoft Azure environment using compromised service principals.
card_summary: The threat actor known as JADEPUFFER has been observed orchestrating destructive actions within a Microsoft Azure environment using compromised service principals.

sections.context: This fits the broader data-exposure trend where follow-on abuse of leaked information is common.

email_summary: The threat actor known as JADEPUFFER has been observed orchestrating destructive actions within a Microsoft Azure environment using compromised service principals. Microsoft, which is tracking the activity under the name Storm-3168, has called it an evolution of the threat actor's tradecraft.

title: CISA Says Attackers Are Exploiting Two Critical Citrix NetScaler Flaws Globally
summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Sunday added two critical Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation.
card_summary: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Sunday added two critical Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation.
email_summary: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Sunday added two critical Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation. Tracked as CVE-2026-88771. Severity is rated critical.

title: US soldier gets 70 months in prison for extorting 10 tech, telecom firms
